name: Chou Gedou Yuusha
source:
Lux is a knight and he is about to hunt down the devil. Just when he gives the devil the final blow, he suddenly says, "You're pretty as I heard. You just entertain me more...." "What!? What are you doing...?" Like this, he rapes the devil.... The devil says, "Just kill me...!" However, Lux is more cruel than the devil.... "Do you think I'm already satisfied? This is just the beginning...."

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090106150613/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011629]ErogeShop[/url]]
translation:
路克斯是一名骑士，正准备讨伐魔王。就在他要给魔王最后一击时，却突然说道：“你果然像传闻中一样漂亮。再多取悦我一会儿吧…”
“什么！？你在做什么…？”
就这样，他强奸了魔王…魔王哀求道：“杀了我吧…！”然而，路克斯甚至比魔王更加残酷…
“你以为我已经满足了吗？这才刚刚开始…”

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090106150613/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1011629]ErogeShop[/url]]
